title: What do you make of me?
notes: She reads the uniform the way anybody would and commits to nothing (CAPTAIN.md 6,
COMMS.md 6.1). What the player told Shepard is not stored, so she cannot know it.

lines.text: You're wearing the uniform. I'll take that at face value.
Where you got it is your business.
You don't dress like one of mine. That's all right.
You came up off Shepard's shuttle and you've kept her flying.
Then you're a long way from home, like the rest of us.
I don't need to know what you were. I care what you do next.
